alt.en: A seated Buddha in a red and gold robe rises above eight standing, haloed bodhisattvas on darkened silk.
alt.zh: 深色绢地上，穿红金色袈裟的坐佛位于八位立姿、带背光的菩萨上方。

caption.en: Korea, mid–late fourteenth century. Ink, colour and gold on silk; an unidentified artist of the late Goryeo period.
caption.zh: 朝鲜半岛，十四世纪中晚期。绢本水墨设色及金彩；高丽晚期画家，姓名未详。

interpretation.en: Gold patterns, translucent garments and an ordered assembly give Buddhist devotion a visual form. The museum identifies Amita at the center and Kshitigarbha in the simpler hooded garment. The painting’s original patron and temple are unidentified.
interpretation.zh: 金色纹样、轻透衣饰与有序群像赋予佛教信仰可见的形式。馆方将中央尊像认定为阿弥陀佛，穿简朴兜帽衣袍者为地藏菩萨。原始委托者与所属寺院未详。

alt.en: A low star-shaped ceramic lamp has a central opening, smaller holes and projecting spouts with traces of blue-green decoration.
alt.zh: 低矮星形陶灯中央开孔，周围有小孔与外伸灯嘴，表面留有蓝绿色装饰。

caption.en: Syria, twelfth–thirteenth century, Ayyubid period. Stone-paste painted underglaze; maker unknown.
caption.zh: 叙利亚，十二至十三世纪，阿尤布时期。釉下彩石英陶；制作者未详。

interpretation.en: Six projecting spouts and blue-green surfaces combine lighting with ceramic craftsmanship. The catalogue places the lamp in Ayyubid Syria; its workshop and original setting are unknown.
interpretation.zh: 六个外伸灯嘴与蓝绿色表面，将照明需求与陶工技艺结合起来。目录将其归于阿尤布时期的叙利亚，具体作坊与原始使用场所未详。

title.en: The Art of the Ayyubid Period
A pitcher that failed in production

alt.en: A badly distorted ceramic pitcher leans on its foot, with a broken neck and iridescent patches over dark painted decoration.
alt.zh: 严重变形的陶壶斜立于圈足上，颈部残损，深色彩绘上覆盖虹彩斑块。

caption.en: Raqqa, Syria, twelfth–thirteenth century, Ayyubid period. The museum catalogues this stone-paste pitcher as a waster: a rejected product.
caption.zh: 叙利亚拉卡，十二至十三世纪，阿尤布时期。馆方将此石英陶壶记为窑废品，即未合格的产品。

interpretation.en: The collapsed shape records the risk behind finished ceramics. Black painting beneath blue glaze combined forming, decoration and firing, and some vessels failed in production. Raqqa is the catalogue attribution; its excavation context is unrecorded.
interpretation.zh: 塌陷形态记录了成品陶器背后的风险。蓝釉下的黑彩结合成形、装饰与烧制工序，有些器物在生产中失败。拉卡为目录所记产地，考古出土背景未载。
